Thanks for expressing interest in a short group roundtable to walk through Redwood Inference’s serving runtime and cost/performance controls. We’re planning a single 45-minute session (30m demo + 15m Q&A) and want to make sure we pick a slot that works for both NA/EU and APAC prospects.

- Option A: Tue, Oct 19 — 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET (good for NA)
- Option B: Wed, Oct 20 — 4:00 PM GMT / 5:00 PM CET (better for EU)

If neither works, there’s a space in the poll to suggest alternate times; link below. If there's demand from APAC attendees, we can run a second back-to-back session targeted at SGT/HKT.

Quick asks:
